integrity: The exact crossing formula is proved symbolically from the published braid word, genus, and braid index together with Yamada's theorem. The volume-density limit uses the published fixed-parent filling description and the standard strict volume-decrease theorem. No finite experiment substitutes for an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the Baker--Teragaito family with \(n\ge1\). It gives a uniform upper bound on hyperbolic volume and a zero volume-density limit, not exact volumes or volume monotonicity. It does not classify all braid-index-four L-space knots.
title: Zero volume density at the minimal asymmetric L-space braid index
